verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing documents that teammates can share one number ('Share one number and stay aligned with your team') and offers call routing and ring orders. Nothing in the evidence shows presence indicators, conversation assignment, or internal team threads. Missing for 10: presence/availability status, conversation assignment to teammates, internal notes or threads on conversations, in-depth first-party docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads
